description: This file is the main route component for a notes application frontend built with Remix framework. It includes data fetching, form handling, and UI components for displaying, creating, editing, and deleting notes.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Fetches the list of notes and, if a noteId is specified, fetches that specific note for display.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles create, update, and delete operations for notes based on form submissions.

methods.name: NotesApp
methods.description: Main React component that renders the notes application UI, including sidebar and detail/edit pane.
